item.title: Mini Whisper 0.7.0
item.description:
Added

  • One main window. Its sidebar holds search, Start Meeting, Meetings, Dictations, Settings and a usage table of today's and this month's tokens, audio time and cost. ⌘1, ⌘2, ⌘, and ⌘N go to a page, ⌘F searches, ⌘[ leaves a finished meeting, ⌘W hides the window. Closing it never stops a recording; its size and place are kept in config.json (main_window_frame).
  • One search over meeting titles, transcripts, notes and summaries and stored dictations.
  • Theme: Settings → General → Appearance → System, Light or Dark (theme in config.json). The dictation overlay is unchanged.
  • Regenerate on a finished meeting, after confirming the current summary's cost. That summary stays until the new one arrives, and stays if the request fails; its cost stays in the meeting's total (replacedSummaryCostUSD in meeting.json).
  • Copy summary: the title and summary as Markdown, HTML and RTF.

Changed

  • A new look for every window but the overlay, light and dark, recorded in DESIGN.md.
  • Meetings, Dictations (formerly History) and Settings are pages of the main window; the menu's *History...* is *Dictations…*. A meeting is a page too: the chooser, the live meeting, then the finished meeting with Summary, Transcript and Notes tabs. While a meeting runs, a recording pill in the sidebar leads back to it.
  • Summaries are written by topic and end with Next Steps; they display as headings and lists. A summary_prompt.txt still holding the previous default is replaced at launch; an edited one is kept. Four-section summaries still display.
  • A Meetings row shows the summary's topics under its title, else its first sentence, else the transcript's first line.
  • The menu's Month row shows tokens and audio time, as Today does. Audio time of an hour or more reads 2h 14m.
  • The Dock icon stays while any Mini Whisper window is open.
  • Correction, Onboarding and About follow the new look; About is a window, not an alert.

Removed

  • The Meetings, History, Settings and Meeting windows.
  • The search fields of the meetings and history lists.
  • Settings' *Open History…* and *Open Meetings…* buttons.
  • The finished meeting's Meetings button; its back button (⌘[) returns to the page it was opened from.

item.title: Mini Whisper 0.6.2
item.description:
Added

  • Settings → Meetings shows how to add the MCP server to the ChatGPT app for Mac, with the command to paste.
  • A finished meeting's window has a Meetings button that closes it and opens the list.

item.title: Mini Whisper 0.6.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • The 0.6.0 fix for quiet remote calls did not take effect: other apps still dropped about 30 dB while a remote meeting recorded, and the call still reached the transcription engine too quiet. Other apps now drop about 8 dB and the call reaches the engine at speech level, both measured.

item.title: Mini Whisper 0.6.0
item.description:
Added

  • Test calls. Test Call… in the New Meeting window runs a scripted two-minute remote call: two macOS voices speak through the speakers and you read your lines. Stop scores the transcript against the script — word error rate per speaker and overall, speaker-label consistency and latency — and keeps the score with the meeting for comparison with earlier runs. Eight scenarios, about $0.02 a run. Test calls are marked TEST in *Meetings…* and hidden from the mini-whisper tool and MCP server.

Fixed

  • A remote meeting turned other apps' audio down by about 30 dB, the call included, and the call reached the transcription engine too quiet to transcribe well. Other apps now drop about 7 dB, and the call is raised to speech level before it is mixed with the microphone.

item.title: Mini Whisper 0.5.1
item.description:
Added

  • Meeting mode. ⌃⌥⌘M or *Start Meeting…* records a remote call (microphone plus the audio other apps play) or an in-room meeting (microphone only) with a live, speaker-labelled transcript and timestamped notes; Stop writes a Claude Sonnet 5.5 summary. Four engines: Speechmatics Standard ($0.45/h) and Enhanced ($0.80/h), AssemblyAI Universal-Streaming ($0.27/h) and Universal 3.6 Pro ($0.57/h), the AssemblyAI prices including $0.12/h for speaker labels. Meetings are stored locally in ~/.config/mini-whisper/meetings/, listed and searched in *Meetings…*, exported as Markdown, and billed into the Today/Month rows. Settings → Meetings holds the engine, your name, Keep meeting audio and the summary prompt; config.json gains meeting_hotkey, meeting_engine, meeting_keep_audio, meeting_user_name and meeting_system_audio_explained.
  • The System Audio Recording permission (macOS 14.2+), asked at the first remote call.
  • AssemblyAI and Anthropic keys under Settings → Keys.
  • AssemblyAI Universal-Streaming as a dictation engine ($0.15/h), with vocabulary sent as key terms.
  • The mini-whisper command-line tool, installed from Settings → Meetings: meetings transcript|summary <id> print the exported Markdown, meetings list|search one line per meeting or hit, or JSON with --json. mini-whisper mcp is a stdio MCP server with four read-only tools for Claude Code and other agents. Neither records nor changes a meeting.

Changed

  • The Speechmatics rate is now $0.0075 per minute (was $0.0067): new usage costs more; past Today/Month totals are unchanged.
  • Dictation hotkeys are off while a meeting records or is paused, and starting a meeting cancels a dictation in progress.

item.title: Mini Whisper 0.5.0
item.description:
Added

  • Six overlay animation styles for the recording card: Soft meter, Silk ribbon, Resonant halo, Liquid pearl, Petal iris and the original Constellation. **Soft meter is now the default for every install** — Settings → Overlay picks any of the six beside a live preview that loops a simulated dictation, and Constellation is one click away.

Changed

  • The release pipeline signs the DMG itself, not just the app inside it, and refuses to submit an image hdiutil cannot verify. Gatekeeper can now assess the download on its own signature; 0.4.0 and earlier shipped an unsigned image.

item.title: Mini Whisper 0.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • Automatic updates, via Sparkle. Mini Whisper checks for a new version once a day, shows the changelog entry for it, and installs and relaunches once you approve. Check for Updates… in the menu bar checks on demand; Settings → General turns the daily check off. Homebrew no longer needs to upgrade the app, and no longer tries to.
  • This release has to be installed the old way. 0.3.1 and earlier have no updater, and the cask is now auto_updates true, so plain brew upgrade skips it. Run brew upgrade --cask --greedy mini-whisper (or install the DMG) once to get here; updates are automatic from then on.
